import os
import sys

text_files = [f for f in os.listdir() if f.endswith(".txt")]
if text_files:
    with open(text_files[0]) as fh:
        print("files:" + fh.read())
else:
    stdin_data = sys.stdin.read()
    if stdin_data:
        print("stdin:" + stdin_data)
    else:
        print("hello")
